signals.summary: Cut about 800 jobs, roughly 1% of the 80,000-person global workforce, concentrated in technology and product-delivery teams.
Reported $37.7 billion in 2025 revenue, up 15% year over year, with $7.1 trillion in managed assets.
Plans roughly 3,300 new hires in 2026, including about 1,650 in technology and product and 2,000 early-career staffers.
Had 2,000 open roles, including 400 in tech or product delivery, and planned to hire thousands more.
Expanding into new Boston Seaport District offices while keeping its downtown headquarters, to seat employees returning five days a week.
